incremental_mechanism: goal-setting and points-based feedback added to common self-monitoring app
comparator_backbone: common app with tracking, feedback and education
engagement_signal: usage measured; detailed exposure frequency NR
key_structural_read: Useful for component decomposition during acquisition, but says little about persistence after exposure stops.

incremental_mechanism: tailored motivational feedback and theory-targeted web features
comparator_backbone: both groups received scheduled email prompts and internet access; control used public PA websites
engagement_signal: enhanced arm logged in substantially more often
key_structural_read: Early advantage disappeared by 6 months as the comparator group improved.

comparator_backbone: both groups used the same monitoring/notification app; goals differed
engagement_signal: frequent app use in roughly half of each arm
key_structural_read: Adaptive goals improved relative trajectory, but both groups still declined in absolute steps.

incremental_mechanism: tailored web advice plus PAM monitoring
comparator_backbone: both advised to increase PA; control received general PA brochure
engagement_signal: 73% regular/often PAM wear; 74% read tailored advice
key_structural_read: No clear PA benefit at intervention end or 5 months later despite substantial exposure.

incremental_mechanism: automated tailored barrier support, planning, feedback and reminders
comparator_backbone: both wore monitors and received basic verbal advice; control lacked web/mobile support
engagement_signal: weekly participation fell from >85% early to ~75% later
key_structural_read: Active-period benefit cannot identify which package component mattered and no post-intervention durability was tested.

incremental_mechanism: three daily SMS prompts added to Fitbit self-monitoring
comparator_backbone: both groups used Fitbit and received brief goal/motivation support
engagement_signal: about half judged 3 messages/day too many; some stopped reading
key_structural_read: High-frequency automated contact produced only a week-1 advantage and likely reduced attention.

incremental_mechanism: targeted SMS added to shared walking resources
comparator_backbone: all groups received walking maps, website resources and PA guidance
engagement_signal: message delivery known; actual reading/response not measured
key_structural_read: Midpoint advantage largely reflected less decline, not clear activity gain, and disappeared by week 24.

comparator_backbone: intervention added mobile program to usual cardiac-rehab care
key_structural_read: Walking/leisure PA improved without corresponding peak-VO2 advantage.

incremental_mechanism: personal feedback versus personal + social-comparison feedback
comparator_backbone: all groups used identical step-recording smartphone; feedback layer differed
primary_failure_mode: no incremental value of added social comparison
key_structural_read: Personal feedback added value over no feedback; social comparison did not clearly add value beyond personal feedback.

comparator_backbone: regular and plus shared app+counseling+accelerometer in acquisition; maintenance differed by app continuation
key_structural_read: Continuing the diary/app during maintenance did not outperform accelerometer-only maintenance.

comparator_backbone: educational control; intervention stages changed according to response
engagement_signal: week-6 responder classification; follow-up self-monitoring continued
key_structural_read: Promising responder trajectories, but the design does not support a simple 'gamification worked' interpretation.

incremental_mechanism: online training and peer support layered on tracker + PAI app
comparator_backbone: all arms received tracker + PAI; added training and then peer support
engagement_signal: accelerometer completeness fell to 42.7% by 18 months
primary_failure_mode: no durable incremental value from extra components
key_structural_read: More digital components produced only temporary separation before convergence over 18 months.

incremental_mechanism: JITAI coaching added to step-counter self-monitoring
comparator_backbone: both groups received step-counter app; coaching was incremental layer
engagement_signal: ~30% of possible daily step data; message reading unverified
key_structural_read: Average JITAI effect was null, but perceived usefulness moderated response.

incremental_mechanism: tracker + professional support versus telephone counseling
comparator_backbone: all participants had completed same prior exercise program; maintenance support differed
engagement_signal: tracker wear ~84%; telephone arm received ~12 calls
key_structural_read: Maintenance success appeared as prevention of decline, with digital and telephone support both plausible preservation routes.

incremental_mechanism: daily step/rank app exposure on top of shared weight-management support
comparator_backbone: both groups received lecture, self-weighing, monthly emails and periodic feedback
engagement_signal: daily app checking ~80% early and ~74% later
key_structural_read: App exposure improved PA trajectory without additional weight loss; incremental app effect sits on a substantial shared backbone.
